gloss: after this, from now on, hereafter

definitions.explanation: From this point forward in time.
Following a specified point in time or event.

examples.japanese: {以後|いご}⟦{気|き}をつけます→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I'll be careful from now on.

examples.japanese: {以後|いご}⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ような→よう：01114_you⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦ように→ように：10081_youni⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I will make sure this doesn't happen again.

examples.japanese: {以後|いご}⟦{注意|ちゅうい}して→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be careful from now on.
I have a meeting after 3 o'clock.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧{以後|いご}、⟦{会|あ}っていない→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I haven't seen them since graduation.

examples.japanese: 4⟦{月|がつ}→月：02230_tsuki⟧{以後|いご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}します→連絡：01524_renraku⟧。

notes:
{以後|いご} means "after" a point in time, or "from now on" when used without a preceding time reference. The boundary point itself may or may not be included.

USAGE:
- Standalone: {以後|いご}⟦{気|き}をつけます→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧ (I'll be careful from now on)
- After time/event: 3⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧{以後|いご} (after 3 o'clock), ⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧{以後|いご} (after graduation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {以後|いご}: after, from now on (slightly formal)
- ⟦{以来|いらい}→以来：01831_irai⟧: since, ever since (emphasizes continuation from that point)
- ⟦{以降|いこう}→以降：03999_ikou⟧: from ~ onward (common in written/official contexts, includes the boundary)
- ⟦これから→これから：01287_korekara⟧: from now (conversational, neutral)

REGISTER:
Somewhat formal. In casual speech, ⟦これから→これから：01287_korekara⟧ or ～⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧ is more natural for "from now on." {以後|いご} often appears in apologies, warnings, or official instructions.
